title: Turn coding into a multiplayer project
description:
If your team is still waiting on engineering for every small change, that’s the real bottleneck.
Builder.io turns your entire product team into builders on real code, not tickets or prototypes.
Designers ship directly into production
PMs validate features in the actual product
QA flags issues in context
Engineers stay focused on what actually matters
The teams that win aren’t coding faster, they’re shipping together.
#ai #softwaredevelopment #webdev #startup #productmanagement
